split_policy: validation and test lists are required; training lists are rejected
censoring: unsupported, failed, and unknown candidates are retained as evidence but excluded from measured rankings
resource_policy: one equal training-step budget and objective-specific inference cost are reported
recommendation_policy: recommend a non-pointwise objective only when its bootstrap regret interval is entirely below pointwise
claim_boundary: No objective superiority claim without identical held-out lists and a confidence-bounded regret improvement.
